title: Unified Modern Hopfield Energy Estimators (scikit-hopfield)
context: Existing libraries leave a critical gap between Modern Hopfield Network theory and practical scikit-learn / PyOD workflows (pytorch-ood only implements degenerate SHE; PyOD lacks Modern Hopfield estimators; knowledge tools lack metastable bifurcation clustering and continuous BAM).
decision: Implement a zero-bloat, NumPy-first scikit-learn-compatible package scikit_hopfield exposing three estimators (HopfieldOOD, HopfieldMetastableCluster, HopfieldBAM) governed by a shared, numerically stable energy core (scikit_hopfield.energy).
consequences: Single mathematical engine powers both IDS Novelty Detection and Associative Knowledge Vaults.
Strict max-shifted logsumexp prevents exponential overflow at high beta values.
